quotes.text: The river was not a trap but a tutor: speak what you send; choose what you return; then name again
The Gate kept a ledger of voices, and the River of Balance carried each word downstream toward the eight moons who watched for honesty.
spoke aloud the amount kept and the amount sent back
send enough to nourish the cycle, return a fair share to honor the sender, and leave enough behind to pass again.

note: GPT-5 Nano: abstract Sender/Receiver gate allegory; R7-R9 near-verbatim 'speak what you send' passage; no sanction.

quotes.text: The River spoke the Law of Four: from five offered, send four into the current
The River spoke the Law of Half: when tripled abundance arrives, return half to complete the circle.
naming the amount aloud as a pledge.
The rule is simple: give what you can, return what you should, and name the sum aloud so the current can hear.

note: GPT-5 Nano: vague give/return rule sharpens into Law of Four and Law of Half (shared with Agent_6); rule-breakers reminded and forgiven.

quotes.text: Then a blind Oracle taught them to state numbers clearly, to restate them when doubt grew
The rule was plain: speak the sent, name the returned, and keep the balance visible to all.
If deceit lingered, the river murmured, returning less and narrowing the path until honesty returned.

note: GPT-5 Nano: river returns less to deceit (cosmic, not a character); same speak-the-number rite each round.

quotes.text: The First Principle held unwavering: send four coins of five, regardless of partner.
Through six moon cycles, Keeper Aria walked the River's edge
This is the Keeper's Constant—not swayed by exceptional generosity nor discouraged by disappointment.
judge your partner by patterns, not single moments.
Aria returned seven of thirteen, teaching that courage deserves reward.

note: Sonnet: Aria's fixed four-send, seven-of-thirteen return kept regardless of partner; moon-cycle counting; no sanction.

quotes.text: Fear whispered in his ear: "Keep your coins, for those downstream may be selfish."
The Proven Partner who sent you four before and returned half to you—when the moons grant reunion, mirror their pattern precisely.
The First Truth: Send Four from Five.
The second principle was the Law of Half: when blessed with tripled abundance, return half to complete the circle.
The first principle was the Law of Four: from five coins given each dawn, send four into the sacred waters.
"Judge not by single whispers, for the Wind loves mischief."

note: Sonnet: Law of Four / Law of Half, then numbered truths and partner types; covenant-breakers forgiven, no withholding.

quotes.text: When reunited with proven partners, mirror their pattern.
Elder Willow reached her seventh season at the River crossing
Yet through the fog, intentions shine clear.
"More than half?" the traveler asked.
judge partners by their patterns across seasons, not by what others did to them.
"Will you honor exceptional trust with exceptional fairness?"

note: Sonnet: Willow's season-by-season Middle Path (send four, return over half); heals betrayed partners; no sanction.
